name: UT Group Co.,Ltd.
summary: UT Group Co.,Ltd. engages in the dispatch and outsourcing of permanent employees in the manufacturing, design and development, construction, and other sectors in Japan. The company offers factory operators, and design and development engineers for manufacturing companies, and various others workers. It also provides worker dispatches, manufacturing outsourcing, business process outsourcing, personnel placement, and support for structural reform for corporate clients. The company was formerly known as UT Holdings Co., Ltd. and changed its name to UT Group Co.,Ltd. in July 2015. UT Group Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
